video_title: 独自露营：山谷入夜后是什么样？
audience: Chinese-speaking viewers who enjoy quiet travel stories and outdoor scenery
visual_hook: The contrast of one small warm refuge against a vast cool night, inviting curiosity without implying danger
subject: One glowing amber camping tent, large enough to read clearly on the right third, on a quiet grassy ledge above a misty mountain valley at blue hour. The tent is the single unmistakable focal object; no people or wildlife are present.
scene_details: Soft layered mountain silhouettes, deep teal-blue sky and navy shadows. Keep the left half deliberately calm and dark for warm-white headline text. Preserve the tent's bright silhouette and entrance, with the lower-right corner left as simple shadowed ground.
